description: 16 completed Kafka trials; separate runs, no averaging or imputation

definitions.processing_backlog: Raw valid Q(t) observations during evaluation; gaps and ownership changes break lines.
definitions.p99: Evaluation messages completed by the drain cutoff, creation to application completion; unfinished percentage retains all acknowledged evaluation messages.
definitions.resources: Requested consumer resources integrated over evaluation and drain (720 seconds), excluding warm-up.
definitions.recovery: Seconds from the scheduled decision to confirmation of Q <= 100 offsets for 30 continuous valid seconds during input.
definitions.activation: Seconds from scheduled decision to verified resulting assignment; this is not a processing pause.
definitions.throughput: Distinct first completions per 10-second interval, including warm-up messages completed during evaluation.
definitions.window_p99: Nearest-rank p99 of full end-to-end latencies for evaluation messages completed within each nonoverlapping 30-second interval; plotted at interval end, excluding drain.
definitions.rolling: Mean skew uses 15 valid observations; processing-backlog growth uses 15 valid growth values. Missing observations and ownership changes leave gaps until windows refill.
